title: Storage bounds decision input (v0.5, D38)
description: Input of the storage-bounds vectors: one decision of the gateway's storage bounds (contract/storage, rules in storage-bounds.md). op check_due: is a size-cap pass due; op cap_pass: which rows of schild.db the size cap deletes and in which order; op disk_budget: does the sum of the configured bounds fit the file system of storage.path; op incident_aggregate: incident numbers and aggregated incidents of a series of blocked requests; op disk_projection: the MVP-21 hint disk_fill_projection. Sizes are bytes, times unix milliseconds. Never sent anywhere.

written_bytes.description: Bytes the event and incident writers wrote to schild.db since the last pass.

kind.description: event: a row of events; incident: a row of incidents (aggregated); agent_call: a row of the agent API call log.

action.description: What a behaviour, rate-limit or distributed event did: observe = shown as "hätte reagiert", anything else enforced.

sampled.description: The request was recorded as a sample (unremarkable, or stopped by a running block).

bytes.description: Bytes the row occupies (payload and index entries).

base_bytes.description: Used bytes of everything the pass never deletes (summaries, settings, users, exceptions, config changes, page overhead).

wal_bytes.description: Size of schild.db-wal after the checkpoint that starts the pass.

floor_rows.description: Newest rows of each class the pass never deletes. The gateway uses storage.FloorRows (100); vectors use small values.

metrics_bound_bytes.description: monitoring.MetricsBoundBytes for the configured keep and website count (0 with monitoring off).

requests_max_size_mb.description: monitoring.requests.max_size_mb, 0 with the request ring off.

body_spool_bytes.description: D41: waf.body.max_in_flight_bytes, the temp space of bodies under storage.path. Absent: not counted.

fs_total_bytes.description: Size of the file system of storage.path (statfs f_blocks x f_frsize).

fs_avail_bytes.description: Bytes available to schild on it (statfs f_bavail x f_frsize).

schild_used_bytes.description: What the bounded files already occupy: schild.db, metrics.db, both WALs and the request ring segments.

client.description: Client key of the behaviour engine (IPv4 address, IPv6 /64), as a keyed token.

rules.description: Rule ids that caused the block (WAF).

limit.description: Request limit code that caused the block (instead of rules).

draw.description: The fresh incident number the gateway would draw for this request.

max_open.description: Open aggregates the gateway keeps in memory (storage.MaxOpenAggregates, 65536); vectors use small values.

min_used_bytes.description: Smallest server.disk_used of the mount on that UTC day.

samples.description: 10-minute points of that day in the ring (144 = complete).

days.description: The last 7 complete UTC days, oldest first.
